name: [BUG] Agent Final Answer includes Agent `Thought` and `Action` · Issue #3873 · crewAIInc/crewAI
snippet: - Repository: crewAIInc/crewAI | Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents. By fostering collaborative intelligence, CrewAI empowers agents to work together seamlessly, tackling complex tasks. | 50K stars | Python ## [BUG] Agent Final Answer includes Agent Thought and Action The Agent Final Answer responds back with Agent Thought and Action instead of a proper response. Context: We use a heirarchial crew wherein a single manager agent delegates tasks to agents like Postgres Agent, MySQL Agent etc. If the task delegated to an Agent comes back with a failure message, then the Manager Agent often replies back with the thought and action fields instead of processing the delegated task response and formatting it properly in the final response. Create a heirarchial crew where manager agent has 2-3 agents to delegate to (say postgres, mysql, etc). Give a query that the agent will possibly fail to execute and work on. The agent should not respond back with the Thought and Action fields that seems to be internal to crewAI and not really required as part of the Agent Final Response. I have designed a heirarchial crew with a manager agent having access to agents like Postgres Expert, MySQL Expert, etc. The User task in this case was - Fetch list of tables from postgres db. [Image: Image | https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d74367ef-2949-4a4e-85de-b4c1acc2297e] > Hi @greysonlalonde , Same issue here, even with 1.4.1 version, > Thanks for confirming @OmixMinana on this. I was able to verify that the issue persisted till v0.193.2. But was having trouble bumping the crewai version further due to dependency conflicts in my project's env > It feels like the agent response is "None". > Mind sharing entire trace to understand more. majiayu000 mentioned this in PR #4144: fix: clean internal format markers from agent output when parsing fails · Dec 22, 2025 at 10:47am > I have similar issue 1.4.1
